project.name: hitorro-fleet-mail-analytics (parent)
project.description: Fleet member that owns durable state for mail analytics on top of the hitorro pipeline: ingest watermarks, saved queries, alert rules, firings, in-app inbox, reports, enrichment suggestions. Backend Spring Boot service + React SPA. Runs Mac-local (H2 + Mac Mail SQLite), Docker, or K8s / Orion (Postgres + IMAP) via the same jar with a profile switch.
